subject.title: #95939 regression: bootstrapMaxChars/bootstrapTotalMaxChars deleted on every restart

question: Should `agents.defaults.bootstrapMaxChars` and `agents.defaults.bootstrapTotalMaxChars` become model-writable through Gateway `config.apply`/`config.patch`, or should they remain file/UI-edited config until restart-time deletion is reproduced?
rationale: The source path that is clear today is a protected config mutation boundary, not the reported restart deletion, and changing it affects the model-to-operator trust boundary described in `src/agents/tools/gateway-tool.ts`.

options.title: Require current-main proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for live restart or config-write proof before changing the Gateway allowlist.

options.title: Approve narrow allowlist expansion
options.body: Treat these two positive integer bootstrap limits as low-risk agent tuning fields and allow an implementation PR with focused guard tests plus live proof.

options.title: Keep file/UI-only editing
options.body: Leave the model-facing allowlist unchanged and close later only if current-main restart deletion cannot be reproduced with concrete evidence.

recommendation.title: Require current-main proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for live restart or config-write proof before changing the Gateway allowlist.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently changed the same Gateway config boundary in PR 90145, making them the best history-backed owner for the allowlist decision.
